meta.originalInput: You blame your willpower for every bad habit, but you are not fighting your impulses. You are fighting your room. Every object in your visual field sends an unconscious micro-demand to your nervous system. A phone on your desk silently drains cognitive bandwidth even when face down. Your brain takes the path of lowest spatial friction every single time. Stop relying on discipline. Re-architect your physical perimeter. Increase friction by two steps for every distraction, and reduce friction to zero for the person you want to become.
